description: Return the date that falls N business days (días hábiles) after a start date in Chile, skipping weekends and national holidays, and list the holidays skipped. Use it for Chilean legal and administrative deadlines; use days_business_days for other countries. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/dias-habiles via x402.

desde.description: Start Date as YYYY-MM-DD; default today. The start day is not counted.

tipo.description: administrativo (default, Monday to Friday), habil-bancario (also skips the bank holiday on December 31) or corrido (calendar days).

name: cl_dias_habiles
title: Chilean deadline in business days
